title: Snap Fitness vs Jetts NZ — 24/7 Budget Gym Comparison 2026
meta_desc: Compare Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ prices, locations, and equipment to find the best 24/7 budget gym
intro: With over 50 locations between them, Snap Fitness and Jetts are two of the most popular 24/7 budget gym chains in New Zealand. But which one offers the best value for money? In this article, we'll compare their prices, locations, and equipment to help you decide. Both gyms offer a range of membership options, including weekly and monthly plans.

sections.heading: Prices and Membership Options
sections.body: Both Snap Fitness and Jetts offer a range of membership options, including weekly and monthly plans. Snap Fitness prices start at $14.95 per week, while Jetts prices start at $12.95 per week. However, Jetts also offers a $10 per week plan for students and seniors.

sections.heading: Locations and Accessibility
sections.body: Snap Fitness has over 30 locations across New Zealand, while Jetts has over 20 locations. Both gyms have a strong presence in major cities like Auckland, Wellington, and Christchurch, but Snap Fitness has a slightly wider reach in smaller towns and cities.

sections.heading: Equipment and Facilities
sections.body: Both Snap Fitness and Jetts offer a range of equipment and facilities, including cardio machines, free weights, and group fitness classes. However, Snap Fitness tends to have more advanced equipment and larger facilities, particularly in their city-centre locations.
list: Group fitness classes (yoga, Pilates, spin classes)

sections.heading: Contract Terms and Cancellation Policies
sections.body: Both Snap Fitness and Jetts offer month-to-month contracts, which can be cancelled with 30 days' notice. However, Jetts has a slightly more flexible cancellation policy, allowing members to pause their membership for up to 3 months per year.

sections.heading: Comparison and Conclusion
sections.body: Ultimately, the choice between Snap Fitness and Jetts will depend on your individual needs and preferences. If you're looking for a more advanced equipment and larger facilities, Snap Fitness may be the better choice. However, if you're on a tighter budget and want a more flexible cancellation policy, Jetts may be the way to go.

sections.heading: Alternatives to Snap Fitness and Jetts
sections.body: If you're not sold on Snap Fitness or Jetts, there are plenty of other budget gym options in New Zealand. Some popular alternatives include Anytime Fitness, F45, and Les Mills.
